$comment: The shared opt-out case table (R-CHAN-5, review finding F17). One row per case: the channel, who sends, the facts about the
recipient, and what the 0015 dispatch guards decide. packages/db/test/dispatch_guard.test.ts inserts every case against the
real guards (app.messages_dispatch_guard / app.calls_dispatch_guard) and asserts 'expect'. The core equivalence test of
module 19 (core-compliance/3.0.0) feeds the same rows to canContact and asserts that it denies every case whose 'expect' is
not 'allow' (core may deny more, never less). An 'unknown' channel must make canContact refuse (deny or throw).
Field meanings: channel 'voice' is an outbound call, every other channel an outbound message. recipientRevoked and
otherPointRevoked are consent revokes on the recipient address and on another live point of the same kind of the same
contact; otherKindRevoked are revokes on a point of another kind of the same contact (for example its phone when the
recipient is a Messenger identity). suppression is an active (unlifted) suppression on the recipient address. personDoNotContact is the contact's own
person-level do-not-contact (its evidence is a revoke on a different address); mergedDuplicateDoNotContact is a duplicate
carrying one that was merged into the recipient contact. keywordWithin24h is an inbound opt-out keyword from the recipient
address on the same thread and channel in the last 24 h. platformCleared is the platform:meta clearance (null: not applicable).
D1 stands: nothing here checks consent level, the DNC registry, quiet hours or caps; only opt-outs block, with no override.
